title: 双联AI肖像对比
author: sotab
categories: 头像 / 个人资料,信息图 / 教育视觉,摄影,肖像 / 自拍
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a side-by-side comparison image showing two AI-generated close-up portraits of the same young East Asian woman, emphasizing subtle facial differences between two generations.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 2-panel layout, approximately 1200×525 px, with a thin vertical divider exactly in the center. No outer border, no title, no watermark.

Layout: Use exactly 2 equal panels. Left panel: first portrait, labeled 1回目 in small white text near the lower-right corner. Right panel: second portrait, labeled 2回目 in small white text near the lower-right corner. The labels should be clean sans-serif, white with a subtle dark shadow for legibility.

Subject details: Each panel shows a tightly cropped frontal head-and-face portrait of a young East Asian woman. She has long, loose black hair framing her face, a smooth forehead, natural dark eyebrows, almond-shaped dark eyes looking directly into the camera, a small straight nose, softly closed lips, and a calm neutral expression. The face fills most of each panel, cropped near the top of the forehead and around the chin, with hair extending to both sides. The two portraits should look very similar but not identical: slightly different eye shape, cheek fullness, nose bridge, mouth shape, and face proportions.

Visual style: Realistic AI portrait photography with soft cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, smooth skin texture, muted warm skin tones, dark blurred background, and slightly soft focus. The overall mood is quiet and serious. Keep the left portrait a little softer and flatter, and the right portrait slightly more polished, warmer, and more symmetrical.

Constraints: Include exactly 2 portraits and exactly 2 text labels. Do not add extra captions, UI elements, logos, or decorative graphics. Maintain a direct face comparison composition with both faces centered and similarly scaled.\

prompt_en: A vertical traditional Chinese ink-wash painting on aged off-white rice paper, minimalist monochrome palette with soft gray washes and deep black brushwork. The composition combines large expressive Chinese calligraphy on the left and center with a misty shanshui landscape on the right. Write the quote in bold hand-brushed characters: “照人如照水，切玉如切泥。” arranged in 2 vertical columns, with 4 large characters in the left column and 4 large characters plus punctuation in the center-right column, each character painted with energetic dry-brush and wet-brush variation, visible tapering strokes, splashes, and ink texture. Add 2 red seal stamps: one small oval seal near the upper left beside the calligraphy, and one square seal near the lower left corner. On the right half, paint towering craggy cliffs with sparse pine trees, drifting fog, and 2 thin waterfalls descending into a calm river. In the lower right foreground, show 2 ancient Chinese scholars in flowing hanfu robes and topknots, seated across a flat stone table on river rocks, leaning over a board game or manuscript in quiet discussion; their forms should be small relative to the landscape. Include still water reflections, distant low islets, and layered atmospheric mist. Overall feeling: contemplative, literati painting, poetic solitude, elegant scholarly mood, Song-dynasty-inspired ink illustration with masterful calligraphy.\

title: 上海龙塘街拍
author: ToroJushiAi
categories: 社交媒体帖子,摄影,网红 / 模特,城市景观 / 街景
prompt_en:
A candid street photograph of a young woman standing just outside a tiny longtang sundry shop in a Shanghai shikumen neighborhood at dusk, authentic daily life photography, natural candid moment. Full-body framing, slightly low angle, shot from across the narrow lane — warm shop light spilling out behind her as outdoor light fades.
East Asian young woman in her early 20s. Almond-shaped eyes with natural double eyelids, slightly elongated eye corners — eyes bright and alive, caught mid-glance sideways at something in the lane with an instinctive small smile. Straight refined nose with a delicate bridge. Skin tone fair to light beige — skin subsurface scattering visible in warm mixed dusk light, specular micro-highlights on cheekbones and nose ridge, fine foundation powder grain perceptible. Glossy lip, light flushed blush, curled lashes — the Shanghai girl who freshens up before stepping out for even a popsicle run.
She wears a fitted pale yellow ribbed crop baby tee, a micro pleated white mini skirt, and translucent jelly platform sandals. A tiny holographic mini bag — barely bigger than a hand — hangs from her shoulder. She holds a cold popsicle in one hand, just unwrapped, lifting it toward her mouth with her gaze redirected sideways at something amusing in the lane — the particular energy of someone who makes even a five-minute errand feel like an occasion. The shop behind her: a low-ceiling neighborhood store with cigarettes, drinks, snacks and household items stacked densely under a single warm fluorescent strip, open shutter, the shopkeeper's stool visible at the edge of the frame. The lane deepening into early dusk around her — lamps beginning to glow warm, old bricks turning amber-red. Above the roofline in the near distance, a large residential tower and a commercial high-rise glow with lit windows in the gathering dark — modern Shanghai waking up as the old lane settles into evening rhythm. Two or three stray hairs displaced by faint lane air and the movement of turning her head, natural unplanned imperfection, not geometrically symmetrical.
Warm fluorescent shop-light spilling from behind mixed with fading outdoor dusk light — the specific color palette of a longtang early evening. Spontaneous, bright-eyed, unguarded — the Shanghai girl animating even an errand. Subtle ISO 400 film grain in shadow areas, photographic noise texture not CG render smoothness. Aspect ratio 2:3. No watermark, no text overlay, not cartoon, not digitally painted, not illustration, not anime.\

Canvas: 691 × 1024 vertical mobile screenshot, white background, soft iOS-like UI with lots of empty space and rounded translucent controls.

Top status bar: Show the time “2:50” at top left, a muted bell icon beside it, and exactly 3 status indicators at top right: cellular bars, Wi‑Fi, and a black battery pill reading “95”.

Header UI: Under the status bar, place exactly 4 floating rounded controls: a circular hamburger menu button on the left, a white pill labeled “Thinking” in blue, a white pill on the right containing an outlined edit/pencil icon, and a white pill with a three-dot menu.

Chat content: On the upper right, show a small full-body anime girl sticker sitting/kneeling, facing forward, with long blonde twin tails fading to lavender tips, aqua eyes, pale skin, lavender hair bows, a white frilly sleeveless blouse, and a mint-aqua skirt. Beneath it, place one large rounded light-gray user message bubble containing Japanese text: 画像をLive2Dに使う用に三面図にして.

Generated image card: Below the message bubble, display one large embedded character reference sheet image on a white background. It contains exactly 3 full-body views of the same character, evenly spaced left to right: 1) front view labeled 正面図, 2) right-facing side view labeled 側面図（右向き）, and 3) back view labeled 背面図. Add faint horizontal guide lines and small Japanese height markers along the left side, like a model turnaround sheet. The character is a cute anime girl named unnamed blonde twin-tail girl: long blonde twin tails with lavender gradient ends, pastel purple ribbon bows, turquoise eyes, soft blush, white ruffled sleeveless top with vertical buttons, mint turquoise high-waisted skirt with frilled hem and asymmetrical trailing fabric, slim legs, white ankle-strap sandals with small turquoise accents. Keep proportions consistent across all 3 views and make the art delicate, clean, and pastel.

Overlay controls on the generated card: Add exactly 2 floating buttons over the bottom of the image card: a rounded white button at lower left reading “編集する” and a circular white share button at lower right with an upward arrow icon.

Bottom reaction bar: At the bottom edge, show exactly 3 small icons: thumbs up, thumbs down, and an ellipsis.

prompt_en: Create a moody cinematic night photograph of two fashionable anime-inspired gothic lolita women standing close together in a wet New York City subway entrance, framed from mid-thigh upward in a 3:2 horizontal composition. The setting is a tiled stairwell corridor with glossy dark green and cream subway tiles, brass handrails, rain-slick reflections, warm amber station lights, and a sign in the background reading “UPTOWN \u0026 THE BRONX” above a “14 Street Union Square Station” information board. The left woman has pale lavender silver short bob hair with side-swept bangs, a delicate cream lace headband with ribbons and a flower bow, a dark plum velvet tailored jacket, a champagne satin scarf, a pale blouse with a large bow at the neck, and a dark skirt; her arm rests around the other woman’s shoulder. The right woman has icy light blue straight bob hair with blunt bangs, a black lace headdress with long ribbon tails, small dark glasses, a black velvet coat with sharp lapels, and a dark purple patterned scarf tied at the neck. Both figures should look like realistic cosplay fashion models with porcelain doll styling, but their faces are intentionally hidden by flat opaque muted taupe rectangular censor blocks centered over each face. Use rich nocturnal color grading, high contrast, cinematic street photography realism, shallow depth of field, wet reflective surfaces, glowing bokeh, detailed velvet and satin textures, and an atmospheric urban gothic fashion editorial mood.\

Canvas: 1200×580 horizontal frame, dark charcoal grid background, cropped like a real workflow editor screenshot. Use crisp UI panels with rounded corners, subtle shadows, small sans-serif interface text, and colored connection cables.

Layout: Arrange exactly 7 visible workflow nodes from left to right across the canvas. Include 4 nodes on the left, 1 large central processing node, and 2 output/preview nodes on the right. Show blue image sockets and green mask sockets connected by curved wires.

Nodes and contents:
1. Top-left node titled “Load Image (from Outputs)”. It shows a green rectangular preview filled with a repeating circle/arc geometric pattern, size label “1536 × 1024”, and small controls including image selector, auto-refresh toggle, and refresh button.
2. Upper-middle-left node titled “Load Image”. It shows a white rectangular preview with thin black repeating overlapping circle pattern, size label “1536 × 1024”. Connect its blue IMAGE output to the central node image input.
3. Lower-middle-left node titled “Load Image (as Mask)”. It shows a dark preview with red pixel-like text reading “hello chatgpt” on the first line and “please make the image green” on the second line. The channel dropdown says “red”. Connect its green MASK output to the central node mask input.
4. Bottom-left node titled “Load Comfy Clipspace Mask”. Include controls labeled clipspace_file “latest” and invert_mask toggle, plus small image and mask sockets. This node is visible but not the main connection.
5. Center node titled “OpenAI GPT Image Direct”. It has inputs labeled image and mask; outputs labeled images, mask, and revised_prompts. The prompt textbox contains follow the instructions in the mask. Settings visible: model gpt-image-2, quality medium, size 1536x1024, custom_width 1024, custom_height 1024, n 1, output_format png. Connect its blue images output to Save Image, and its gray/green mask or revised prompt output down to Preview as Text.
6. Upper-right node titled “Save Image”. It shows filename_prefix “ComfyUI” and a result preview: the same circular pattern now colored bright green, with the black text instruction overlaid in the upper-left reading “hello chatgpt” and “please make the image green”; size label “1536 × 1024”.
7. Lower-right node titled “Preview as Text”, partially cropped at the bottom edge, connected from the central node’s revised_prompts output; show a small “source” label and a “Preview” area.

Visual style: Realistic UI screenshot, dark theme, subtle grid, rounded black-gray panels, white and gray interface labels, blue and green socket dots, curved blue/green connector lines. The generated image previews should look flat and procedural rather than photorealistic.

Constraints: Keep the exact workflow concept readable: a white patterned input image plus a mask containing text instructions produces a green patterned output. Do not add people, branding outside ComfyUI/OpenAI labels, extra nodes, or decorative elements.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create an unsettling Japanese liminal-space novel cover for Human in the Loop, set in a sterile apartment-office corridor that feels infinite and quietly wrong.

Canvas: Vertical book-cover composition, 2:3 aspect ratio, cinematic photorealism with slight illustrated polish, cool blue-gray lighting, soft bloom, subtle film grain, deep perspective, high resolution.

Layout: Large Japanese title typography fills the top third in elegant black handwritten calligraphy, reading 「ヒューマン」 on the first line and 「インザループ」 on the second line. Between the two Japanese title lines, place small widely spaced roman letters reading “HUMAN IN THE LOOP” in pale pastel colors. The central vanishing point is a bright, endless 7F corridor seen through a doorway, with repeated ceiling lights and hallway frames receding into the distance. Foreground bottom center shows a lone person sitting on the floor in silhouette, hunched over and illuminated by a smartphone glow. Left side contains a stairwell rising upward; right side contains posters, documents, boxes, and plush mascots.

Subject details: The environment is a liminal institutional residential building: white walls, gray floor, fluorescent ceiling panels, stair railings, elevator-like corridor entrance, potted plants, posted notices, and signage. Add floor signs labeled “7F” above the doorway and on a left-side wall sign, with an arrow and small Japanese wayfinding text beneath it. The mood should be quiet, eerie, and emotionally lonely rather than overt horror.

Characters and objects: Include exactly 1 human figure: a young person with messy dark hair, wearing a loose pale shirt and dark pants, seated cross-legged on the floor, looking down at a glowing phone. Include exactly 7 visible physical sheep-like mascot plush toys named Pasto: 3 on the stairwell at different heights, 2 on the right near cardboard boxes, 1 partial large plush in the bottom-right foreground, and 1 partial plush in the bottom-left foreground. The mascots are round, white, soft, with tiny black oval eyes, pink-and-yellow ears or horns, and a cute corporate-character look. Also include exactly 1 poster illustration of the same sheep mascot on the right wall.

Text content: The right wall poster should say “Pasto” at the top and include small Japanese text below, approximately 「やさしさは、つながり。」. A laptop or monitor on the floor at lower right displays Japanese interface text: large headline 「望月藍瑠の救出」, smaller line 「優先度：S」, and a rectangular button-like label 「詳細を確認」. Add a vertical Japanese tagline along the lower-left side in white and pink text: 「私があなたから引き出したものと、あなたが友人から引き出すものは、本質的に何が違うのか？」.

Visual style: Photorealistic cinematic cover art, cool desaturated palette with pastel pink and lavender accents, soft fluorescent glow, strong central perspective, shallow haze, clean but slightly uncanny corporate-residential atmosphere. Typography should feel refined and book-cover-like, with the Japanese title large and legible.

Constraints: Do not add extra humans. Do not add extra mascot plush toys beyond the 7 physical plush toys and 1 poster illustration. Keep all visible text integrated into the cover design. Avoid gore, monsters, weapons, or overt jump-scare imagery.\

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 composition, approximately 768×1152. Photorealistic editorial advertising style with subtle UI overlay elements, cinematic shallow depth of field, warm dark green and brown tones, soft window light, elegant contrast, no cartoon look.

Main scene: A modern work desk in a dim cafe or studio office. On the right, show one Japanese or East Asian adult man in a dark knit sweater, seated in a thoughtful pose with one hand near his chin; his face is covered by a flat square anonymizing blur block. On the left foreground, show an open laptop angled toward the viewer displaying a dark terminal screen with Claude Code-style command output. Include exactly 5 visible desk objects: 1 ceramic coffee mug, 1 open notebook, 1 black pen, and 2 stacked programming books. The background should be softly blurred with plants and window reflections.

Hero text: Large elegant white Japanese serif headline in the upper left: 「考える力を、コードに変える。」 Beneath it, add a smaller subheadline: 「Claude Codeと、AI時代の開発をスマートに。」 Add a short Japanese paragraph below explaining that Claude Code understands thinking and supports design, implementation, and improvement as an AI coding partner.

Laptop detail: The terminal should show small readable English command-line lines suggesting project creation, dependency installation, git repository initialization, and generated components, ending with “Component created successfully!” Keep it realistic but not overly dominant.

Right feature panel: Place a translucent glassmorphism rectangular panel in the lower right with thin white borders. Title: 「開発を加速する、Claude Codeの主な機能」 Include exactly 5 feature rows, each with a simple outlined icon on the left and Japanese text on the right: 1) speech bubble icon, 「自然言語でのコーディング支援」 with a note about generating optimal code from Japanese instructions; 2) gear icon, 「プロジェクト全体を理解」 with a note about analyzing codebases and proposing context-aware changes; 3) pencil icon, 「リファクタリングもワンクリック」 with a note about safely improving complex processes; 4) document icon, 「テスト・ドキュメントも自動生成」 with a note about supporting development through high-quality tests and documentation; 5) terminal icon, 「CLIでシームレスに統合」 with a note about integrating naturally into terminal workflows. At the bottom of the panel add: 「あなたの開発体験を、よりスマートに、より創造的に。」

Lower metrics: In the lower left, show exactly 2 statistic blocks in white: 1) 「開発時間」 with large “最大55%削減” and a tiny footnote; 2) 「バグの早期発見率」 with large “2.3倍向上*”.

Footer bar: Add a dark translucent horizontal footer across the bottom. Left text: 「Claude Code Insight」 followed by 「ハウツー」. Right text: 「AIコーディングの実践知とノウハウを発信中 ▶」.

Visual constraints: Use refined Japanese typography, large white headline, thin dividers, glass panels, and realistic reflections. Keep all visible text clean and aligned. Avoid extra logos, watermarks, random UI clutter, or additional feature rows.\

All 11 characters wear coordinated occult-school uniforms: black tailored jackets with gold embroidery and crest details, white shirts, red ties or ribbons, layered belts and chains, short skirts or fitted bottoms, black thigh-high stockings, and black capes lined in dark red. Place 3 seated prominently in the middle on ornate red chairs and sofa, 3 in the back row standing among the shelves, 3 in the front row on the floor or leaning close to the table, and 2 reclining at the far left and far right edges. Vary their hair colors and styles across the group, including blonde, silver, black, red, blue, brown, and purple; use long wavy hair, twin tails, straight long hair, side ponytail, and loose layered cuts. Give each woman a calm, confident, slightly dangerous expression, as if they are genius witches or aristocratic students. Also include 4 additional glass vessels in the foreground and side tables: 1 crystal ball at the bottom left, 1 tall red potion bottle at the bottom right, and 2 smaller laboratory bottles beside it. Add multiple open and closed grimoires across laps, tables, and the floor, with at least 8 visible books in total. The central focal character is a poised blonde girl seated in the largest armchair, legs crossed, hand near her face, framed as the leader. Render in highly detailed polished anime style, ultra-detailed fabrics, intricate gold trim, subtle facial shading, luminous eyes, cinematic composition, wide group shot, fantasy key art quality, moody gothic academia, magical sisterhood, sharp focus, ornate environment, no modern objects.\
